key.name: magnify
key.summary: How the icons grow under the pointer
key.description: swell: the icons grow in a wave under the pointer; lift: only the icon under the pointer rises; off: nothing grows.

key.name: magnify-amount
key.description: The size of the icon under the pointer with Swell, as a multiple of its size at rest.

key.name: launch
key.summary: What an app's icon does while the app starts
key.description: halo: a ring runs round the icon; hop: the icon hops; breathe: the icon pulses; off: no sign. Until its first window opens.

key.name: indicator
key.summary: How a running app is marked
key.description: bar: a bar, longer with two windows or more; dot: a dot for each window; glow: a light under the icon.

key.name: recent
key.description: The last three apps used that are neither pinned nor running, after a divider.

key.name: previews
key.description: Resting the pointer on an app shows its windows above it.

key.name: folders
key.description: Each folder's name and its apps (launcher IDs, two or more, all pinned), the first standing where the folder is.

key.name: stacks
key.description: xdg:NAME for a special folder (DESKTOP, DOCUMENTS, DOWNLOAD, MUSIC, PICTURES, PUBLICSHARE, TEMPLATES, VIDEOS), ~/PATH under the home folder, or an absolute path. Twelve at most.

key.name: edge
key.summary: The edge of the screen the dock is on
key.description: The physical edge, in every language.

key.name: screens
key.description: every: each screen, with the apps whose windows are on it; primary: the main screen only.

key.name: autohide
key.summary: When the dock gets out of the way
key.description: off: always shown, windows stop at it; touch: it hides while a window touches it, and comes back when the pointer is pushed against the edge.

key.name: workspace-apps
key.description: Running apps with no window on the workspace a screen shows leave that screen's dock; pinned apps stay.
